lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Good morning beautiful. I was thinking about our future together all night.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: Morning David. Me too. I wish we could finally meet.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Soon, my love. But first I want us to be financially secure. My uncle works in crypto and showed me a platform with guaranteed returns.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: I already doubled my money. I want the same for you so we can build our life. Just start with $1,000 on this site I'll send you.

lines.speaker: You
lines.text: I've never invested before, I'm a little nervous.

lines.speaker: David
lines.text: Trust me, I would never let anything happen to you. Don't tell your family yet, they wouldn't understand our plan. This opportunity closes today.
